answer: Assume the farm exists. Make every vouch decay: half weight each epoch until the backer re-signs by hand. Publish each failure beside the backer's name, so support becomes a liability. Bind each submission to a fresh nonce and refuse repeats outright. Now the farm needs a thousand renewed edges in public view. One dead voucher collapses the terrace above it, a lotus-clean record takes months to build, and a yarrow patch of fake vouches dies in two epochs.
